data.name: Medieval Fury
data.detailed_description:
Medieval Fury is a fast-paced top-down action game packed with sword-swinging chaos, flashy kills, and nonstop medieval mayhem.

In the Dark Times, one vampire king keeps his crown by stealing children from his people and draining their blood to stay immortal. When he takes your child and your husband dies trying to stop him, you don’t pray — you pick up a sword. From village backstreets to cathedrals and castle halls, you carve a bright, bloody line straight to the throne.

Combat is a rhythm of risk and reward. Fights are tight, readable, and fast: close the gap, bait the swing, tap parry at the last split-second, then riposte to delete armor and send heads rolling. Miss the window and you’ll eat steel. Land it perfectly and you’ll chain counterattacks, staggers, and finishers that clear rooms in seconds. Throwables (knives, axes, torches, pots) spice up routes and enable flashy multi-kills. Every level is a puzzle of angles, corners, and crowd control — read the formation, route the threats, execute.

Your reflexes are the star. Parry timing is quick and gets quicker the longer you survive. Perfect parries slow the world a heartbeat for a cinematic counter. Mess up? Instant restart with zero loading. The game rewards bold routes and stylish kills more than turtle play.

There’s no magic and no chivalry here — only you, your blade, and knights who really should have stayed home today. Bright pixel art and a pumping medieval-synth soundtrack turn every clash into a highlight reel. The tone is sharp, irreverent, and energetic: a mother on a mission, knights in the way, and a king who’s long overdue for early retirement.

Key Features

Reflex-based swordplay: fast reads, tight parry windows, satisfying ripostes, and momentum-driven finishers.

Nonstop flow: instant restarts, snappy rooms, and routes that reward aggression and creativity.

Stylish kills, real scoring.

Varied enemies: armored guards, archers, royal knights with shields.

Playable toys: your swords, plus throwables like knives, torches, and clay pots for distant kills.

Punchy presentation: colorful pixel art, crisp hit-feedback, and a high-energy soundtrack to keep the fury flowing.

Road to the throne: villages, crypts, castle, and the throne room — each a tight arena built for speed routes.

If you’ve got the timing, the nerves, and the hunger for perfect parries, Medieval Fury will make every room a test and every clear a victory you’ll want to replay faster.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7/8
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz P4, Dual Core 2.0 (or higher) or AMD64X2 (or higher)
  • Graphics: Video card must be 128 MB or more and should be a DirectX 9-compatible with support for Pixel Shader 2.0b (ATI Radeon X800 or higher / NVIDIA GeForce 7600 or higher / Intel HD Graphics 2000 or higher - *NOT* an Express graphics card).
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible

content_descriptors.notes: The game features frequent combat scenes depicted in pixel art style. Blood effects are shown during battles, but there is no nudity or sexual content.
